title: Cottages at Eastern Lake Sea La Vie Panhandle Getaways
h1: Cottages at Eastern Lake Sea La Vie
meta_description: Cottages at Eastern Lake beach house rental, Sea La Vie, located in Santa Rosa Beach, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 5 bedroom, 4.5 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. Golf Cart and 4 bikes Included with your stay.
description_expanded: Description Description Cottages at Eastern Lake beach house rental, Sea La Vie, located in Santa Rosa Beach, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 5 bedroom, 4.5 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. Golf Cart and 4 bikes Included with your stay. FEATURES* 5 Bedroom Home on 30A* Golf Cart Included* Large Living Area - 65" TV* Fully Equipped Kitchen with Breakfast Bar* Dining Area* Bedroom 1 - King Bed, 55" TV, En Suite Bathroom* Bedroom 2 - King Bed, 55" TV, En Suite Bathroom * Bedroom 3 - Queen Bed, 55" TV, En Suite Bathroom* Bedroom 4 - Queen Bed, 55" TV* Bedroom 5 - 2 Bunk Beds (T/T, T/T), 55" TV* Washer and Dryer* Complimentary High Speed Wi-Fi* Sleeps 12 30A Beach Access Points Surveillance Device - Please note there are 6 surveillance devices on the exterior of the home and at home entry points. ***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) THE COTTAGES AT EASTERN LAKEWelcome to The Cottages at Eastern Lake, an idyllic coastal community nestled along the picturesque shores of 30A in Santa Rosa Beach. Immerse yourself in the serene beauty of coastal living as you discover our charming community, perfectly situated near the tranquil Eastern Lake. Our community offers a sanctuary of relaxation and leisure, where the gentle ocean breeze mingles with the rustle of lush greenery, creating a tranquil ambiance that rejuvenates the soul. At The Cottages at Eastern Lake, residents and guests alike enjoy an array of amenities designed to enhance coastal living. Dive into relaxation at our community pool, where sparkling waters invite you to unwind beneath the warm Florida sun. Embrace the art of outdoor grilling amidst our scenic surroundings, as friends and family gather for memorable cookouts and gatherings. Beyond the comforts of home, our community is a gateway to the natural wonders of Santa Rosa Beach. Explore the pristine shores of Eastern Lake, where shimmering waters beckon for kayaking, paddleboarding, and serene moments of reflection. Embark on scenic nature walks amidst verdant landscapes, where the beauty of coastal flora and fauna captivates at every turn. Whether you seek adventure or tranquility, The Cottages at Eastern Lake offers a coastal lifestyle like no other. Experience the essence of seaside living, where every day unfolds with the promise of sun-kissed moments and cherished memories. Community HighlightsResort Style Pool with Plenty of SeatingBeach Access Natural Preserve Feel with Plenty of Shade INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVALPanhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens & towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach. Read less
